### 🟦 **Blue – Personnel & Lineup Changes**

> **Band Members and Lineup Evolution**  
- Brothers Rob and John Wright formed Nomeansno in 1979 as a two-piece (bass and drums).  
- Andy Kerr joined in 1983, playing guitar; departed late 1991 after touring and emigrated to the Netherlands.  
- After Kerr’s departure, the Wright brothers focused on their side project *The Hanson Brothers*.  
- For the *Why Do They Call Me Mr. Happy?* tour (1993), the band expanded to include:  
  - **Tom Holliston** (guitarist) – member of *The Hanson Brothers*; remained until 2016.  
  - **Ken Kempster** (second drummer) – also from *The Hanson Brothers*.  
- Holliston later called this album his favorite Nomeansno record.  

> **Solo Work & Side Projects**  
- Rob Wright began working on solo material under the name **Mr. Wrong**.  
- Several tracks on the album were drawn from the *Mr. Wrong* project.

---

### 🟩 **Green – Recording Details (Studio, Engineers, Sessions)**

> **Recording Locations & Studio Work**  
- Demo tracks recorded at **Dollhouse Studio** (February 1993).  
- Final versions recorded at **Cecil English's Profile Sound Studios**.  

> **Production & Engineering Crew**  
- **Engineered by**: Brian Else  
- **Produced by**: Nomeansno  
- **Mixed by**: Brian Else, Nomeansno, and **Craig Bougie** (longtime roadie)  

> **Studio Experiments & Samples**  
- Final track, *"Cats, Sex, and Nazis"*, features audio samples of:  
  - Faith No More – *"We Care a Lot"*  
  - The Residents  
  - Deep Purple  
  - Previously released Nomeansno song – *"I Am Wrong"*

> **Outtakes & Compilations**  
- Four outtakes from these sessions were later released on *Mr. Right & Mr. Wrong: One Down & Two to Go*.

---

> **Tracks Originally Written During Andy Kerr’s Tenure**  
- *"I Need You"* – recorded with Kerr as an outtake from *0 + 2 = 1* sessions  
- *"Cats, Sex, and Nazis"* – originally recorded with Kerr; later released on *0 + 2 = 1 ½*  
- *"Happy Bridge"* – initially recorded as a demo with Kerr; later released on *0 + 2 = 1 ½*  

> **Tracks from Mr. Wrong Project**  
- *"The Land of the Living"*  
- *"The River"*  
- *"Machine"*  
- *"Lullaby"*  
→ All four were taken from the *Mr. Wrong* set  

> **New Compositions**  
- The remaining three tracks (not listed above) were new compositions by the Wright brothers.  

> **Track Attribution Note**  
- All songs written by Nomeansno, **except tracks 5, 7, and 10**, which were co-written by Nomeansno and **Andy Kerr**.

> **Note on Format Differences**  
- CD version (1993, Alternative Tentacles): 10 tracks  
- LP version (1993, Alternative Tentacles): Tracks 1–6 and 10 only (omits tracks 7–9)

### 🟥 **Red – Critical Reception & Reviews**

> **Critical Acclaim**

> **The Guardian – John Doran (2016)**  
- Called it *"the high watermark of western civilization"* in a retrospective review.
